sources.title: NIST SP 800-63A
sources.excerpt: CSPs SHALL have a documented and publicly available deletion process and default retention period for all biometric information.

mappings.rationale: Biometric information is associated with an enrolled subscriber and has an explicit deletion lifecycle.

sources.title: W3C PROV-O
sources.excerpt: A derivation is a transformation of one entity into another.

mappings.rationale: PROV-O explicitly represents derivation chains between entities.

sources.title: OpenSearch Delete snapshot
sources.excerpt: To verify that the snapshot was deleted, use the Get snapshot API, passing the snapshot name.

mappings.rationale: A snapshot is independently queryable and requires its own deletion verification.

sources.title: MLflow Backend Stores
sources.excerpt: Run metadata and artifacts are not automatically removed from the backend store or artifact store when a Run is deleted.

mappings.rationale: MLflow separates metadata and artifacts and deletion of one does not automatically delete the other.

sources.title: PostgreSQL Continuous Archiving
sources.excerpt: You need to retain files needed to recover from at least the latest base backup.

mappings.rationale: Archived WAL and a base backup can restore prior database state.
